# FleetProof project instructions

1. This project is FleetProof, a logistics proof-of-delivery (POD) capture and billing application.
2. Backend functionality already exists. Frontend development must integrate with it rather than rebuilding it.
3. Always inspect the existing code before creating or changing files.
4. Follow the installed Agent Skills in `.github/skills/` when they are relevant to a task.
5. Do not modify backend code unless explicitly requested.
6. Do not invent API endpoints, response fields, database models, or business rules.
7. Do not use placeholder data when real backend data is available.
8. Never create buttons that do nothing.
9. Every page must have appropriate loading, empty, and error states.
10. Maintain a consistent design system.
11. Build responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
12. Preserve existing working functionality.
13. Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
14. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
15. Before implementing a feature, explain which existing files and APIs it will use.
